title: The EUROSCA Natural History Study
summary: The key goals of EUROSCA-NHS is to determine and compare the rate of disease progression in SCA1, SCA2, SCA3 and SCA6 including determination of the order and occurrence of non-ataxia symptoms, assessment of activities of daily living (ADL) and quality of life (QoL), and identification of predictors of disease progression and survival.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Progressive, otherwise unexplained ataxia
* Positive genetic testing for SCA1, SCA2, SCA3, and SCA6
* Written informed consent by the patient or his legal agent

Exclusion criteria:

None.
